summary_zh:
這裡是我認為，全冰島最美的一段山路一。

由於這是一個「路段」，而不是一個專門景點，所以只能以明顯的地標 「Bjarnarhafnarfjall」為主。

從 54 公路往前開，下坡後眼前會看到一座橋，先別上橋，在前面旁邊的路邊停車場，停好車，你就會看到這影像。

確切的 GPS 座標如下：

64°57'53.1"N 23°01'18.0"W
summary_en: This stretch is, in my opinion, the most beautiful mountain road in all of Iceland. Since it is a road segment rather than a dedicated site, use the prominent landmark “Bjarnarhafnarfjall” as the reference point. Drive north from Route 54; after a downhill section you’ll see a bridge. Do not cross the bridge—park in the roadside parking lot just before it. From the parking area you’ll have a clear view of the road. The exact GPS coordinates are 64°57'53.1"N 23°01'18.0"W. No restroom facilities are available, and parking is free. Recommended stay: about 30 minutes.
